name: FRS Columbia
old_description: FRS offers commercial kitchen equipment and quality restaurant supplies to customers throughout the Carolinas.
about:
FRS Foodservice & Restaurant Supply, based in Columbia, South Carolina, has served the Carolinas for more than 50 years. The company is now part of the Innovative Foodservice Group (IFG) family of companies.

The company operates four fully stocked showrooms across Asheville, Charleston, Columbia, and Florence, functioning as a single regional provider. It specializes in commercial kitchen equipment and a broad selection of restaurant, bar, and kitchen wares. Through its affiliation with IFG, FRS offers centralized billing, centralized purchasing, and rapid inventory transfers between locations.

FRS serves restaurants, bars, and foodservice operators throughout the Carolinas, with a customer base spanning Asheville, Charleston, Columbia, and Florence. The company also supports industry organizations that provide educational programs and networking opportunities for foodservice professionals.

FRS emphasizes a combination of competitive pricing and localized service, describing its approach as a 'local touch with a global reach' backed by IFG's purchasing power. The company positions itself as a trusted local partner for foodservice operators.
